models.description: eSSVI global surface (theta, psi, rho per expiry); Hendriks-Martini calendar and Gatheral-Jacquier butterfly conditions imposed; inverse half-spread weights
raw SVI per expiry; Durrleman g(k) >= 0 on 241 points of k in [-1.5, 1] and Lee wing bounds; no calendar constraint between slices; inverse half-spread weights
Heston at the stored model_version-2 joint SPX/VIX-index fit (DE + L-BFGS-B on 53 z-grid anchors and 4 VIX indices; repo Lewis engine)

notes: Every model is scored on the same quotes (the calibrator's OOS universe) with the same metrics and dense-grid checks.
Surfaces are fitted to alternate strikes; Heston's in-sample set is its 53 calibration anchors, fitted jointly with the VIX index leg.
Yahoo snapshots carry no quote time: part of every model's spread misses can be stale quotes rather than model error.
